subject: 9e068c70-b83b-4214-ae6b-b8bf83c4fd35
object: The Japanese concept of the artisan-craftsman (職人) whose mastery is inseparable from moral discipline — the commitment to making each piece as well as it can be made, regardless of whether anyone will notice. Closely related to monozukuri (ものづくり), the art of making things, where the process of production is itself a form of knowledge.
